# google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy_binding

An AutoProtectionPolicyBinding applies an AutoProtectionPolicy to a scope, such as a
project. Once bound, the policy automatically protects the eligible resources in that
scope that match its criteria.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about AutoProtectionPolicyBinding, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/backup-disaster-recovery/docs/reference/rest/v1beta/projects.locations.autoProtectionPolicies.bindings)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/backup-disaster-recovery/docs)

~> **Note:** Deleting a binding is asynchronous: `:initiateDelete` transitions the binding to the
`DELETION_INITIATED` state while the API unprotects the resources in the binding's scope
in the background before removing the binding. By default (`wait_for_delete = false`),
Terraform returns as soon as `:initiateDelete` completes. While a binding is in
`DELETION_INITIATED`, the parent `AutoProtectionPolicy` cannot be deleted. Set
`wait_for_delete = true` to wait until background unprotection finishes and the binding
is completely removed.

## Example Usage - Backup Dr Auto Protection Policy Binding Basic


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {
  provider = google-beta
}

resource "google_backup_dr_backup_vault" "my_backup_vault" {
  provider                                   = google-beta
  location                                   = "us-central1"
  backup_vault_id                            = "bv-app-binding"
  backup_minimum_enforced_retention_duration = "100000s"
}

resource "google_backup_dr_backup_plan" "my_backup_plan" {
  provider       = google-beta
  location       = "us-central1"
  backup_plan_id = "bp-app-binding"
  resource_type  = "compute.googleapis.com/Instance"
  backup_vault   = google_backup_dr_backup_vault.my_backup_vault.id

  backup_rules {
    rule_id               = "rule-1"
    backup_retention_days = 5

    standard_schedule {
      recurrence_type  = "HOURLY"
      hourly_frequency = 6
      time_zone        = "UTC"

      backup_window {
        start_hour_of_day = 0
        end_hour_of_day   = 24
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy" "my_policy" {
  provider                  = google-beta
  location                  = "us-central1"
  auto_protection_policy_id = "app-binding"

  criteria {
    matching_conditions {
      label_condition {
        key    = "backup-policy"
        values = ["gold"]
      }
    }
  }

  backup_plan_details {
    resource_type = "compute.googleapis.com/Instance"
    backup_plan   = google_backup_dr_backup_plan.my_backup_plan.name
  }
}

resource "google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy_binding" "my-binding" {
  provider                          = google-beta
  location                          = "us-central1"
  auto_protection_policy_id         = google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy.my_policy.auto_protection_policy_id
  auto_protection_policy_binding_id = "my-project-binding"
  scope                             = "projects/${data.google_project.project.project_id}"
  wait_for_delete                   = false
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `scope` -
  (Required)
  The container that the policy is applied to, in the format `projects/{project}`.

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the auto protection policy.

* `auto_protection_policy_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the auto protection policy to bind.

* `auto_protection_policy_binding_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the binding. This becomes the final component of the binding's resource name.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
* `wait_for_delete` - (Optional) Whether Terraform should wait for the binding and all associated background resource
unprotection operations to be completely deleted before returning. Setting
`wait_for_delete = true` will block the Terraform script/execution until all resources
are unprotected and the binding is fully removed.



## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/autoProtectionPolicies/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}/bindings/{{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the binding, in the format
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/autoProtectionPolicies/{auto_protection_policy_id}/bindings/{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}`.

* `state` -
  The current state of the binding.
  Possible values are `CREATING`, `ACTIVE`, and `DELETION_INITIATED`.

* `etag` -
  The etag of the binding, used for optimistic concurrency control.

* `create_time` -
  The time when the binding was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time when the binding was last updated.

* `binding_evaluation_summary` -
  A summary of the last run of the job that applies the policy to matching resources within the binding's scope.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_binding_evaluation_summary).


<a name="nested_binding_evaluation_summary"></a>The `binding_evaluation_summary` block contains:

* `matching_resource_count` -
  (Output)
  The number of resources that currently match the policy's criteria.

* `protected_resource_count` -
  (Output)
  The number of matching resources that are successfully protected.

* `failed_resource_count` -
  (Output)
  The number of matching resources whose protection failed during the last job run.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 60 minutes.

## Import


AutoProtectionPolicyBinding can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/autoProtectionPolicies/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}/bindings/{{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}/{{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}/{{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import AutoProtectionPolicyBinding using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    autoProtectionPolicyId = "<-required value->"
    autoProtectionPolicyBindingId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy_binding.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import AutoProtectionPolicyBinding using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/autoProtectionPolicies/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}/bindings/{{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}}"
  to = google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy_binding.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), AutoProtectionPolicyBinding can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy_binding.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/autoProtectionPolicies/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}/bindings/{{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}}
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy_binding.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}/{{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}}
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_auto_protection_policy_binding.default {{location}}/{{auto_protection_policy_id}}/{{auto_protection_policy_binding_id}}
```
